name: I-13
one_line: a four-plane agent stack over a thirteen-symbol language, where two planes learn, two do not, and five parameter-free rules hold what no model at this scale holds

delta_from_v1.what: the tower is FOUR planes, not seven
delta_from_v1.evidence: two-proportion tests on the leaf fraction: L5 vs L6 p=0.5407, L5 vs L7 p=0.9362, L6 vs L7 p=0.7403, and L4 vs L5 p=0.0795. separating L6 from L5 at the observed 2.99 points needs 1,426 nodes; L6 has 73 and L7 has 17.
delta_from_v1.action: L5, L6 and L7 deleted. L4 absorbs them: 6,662 nodes, 7,143 chars, one cortex, error 0.97+/-0.45 pts, KS 0.0490 < 0.0729, five seeds.

delta_from_v1.what: the RISC-13 spill path was silently wrong from arity 8
delta_from_v1.evidence: forced spill at 8 arguments returned 28[object Object] instead of 36; every spilled argument reloaded into R-1, so only the last survived, and CALL then read past an 8-slot register file.
delta_from_v1.action: replaced with a calling convention: up to R-1 args in registers, the rest in named memory slots with a fetch flag on CALL. verified arity 4 to 45, no regression. the generic spill in ex() was deleted as unfixable in principle.

delta_from_v1.what: (c(sa())) — the cortex became a SENSOR as well as a governor
delta_from_v1.evidence: feeding the cortex's own state back as input features: L2 mismatch 15.0+/-2.1 -> 0.6+/-0.8 with no correction running; L1 stray-close 65.0 -> 1.0. six floats at L2, five at L1.
delta_from_v1.action: locked into both trained planes. the cortex still verifies at the end: a feature is advice, a veto is a wall.

delta_from_v1.what: BASELINE CONTROL run — the missing number from v1
delta_from_v1.evidence: GRU 16,936 params: 0.8440 bits, 79.6% brackets, 33.8 mismatch, 16.6/40 clean. transformer 14,944 params: 0.9299 bits, 78.0%, 65.6 mismatch, 7.8/40. locked sa+cortex 18,921 params: 0.9118 bits, 80.6%, 0.0 mismatch, 40.0/40.
delta_from_v1.action: the GRU BEATS the sub-agent on prediction and produces 2.3x the mismatched closers. learned recurrent state is not a stack. the cortex is orthogonal to model quality, not a substitute for it.

planes.csa: 5 features: depth, open, terminator, header, run
planes.verified: 5 seeds x 20 samples. stray-close 65.0 -> 1.0 with features. unclosed 91.6 -> 0.0 with -I ONLY: a sensor tells you where you are, a discharge brings you back.

planes.metric: 18,921 params - 0.9118 bits - 80.6% brackets - 98.90% of all lines
planes.verified: 40/40 clean, 5 seeds, ZERO VARIANCE. 9 languages 1957-2017, 529 unclosed to 0.

planes.name: COMPOSE
planes.verified: 200 generated programs: correctness 200/200, termination 200/200 (stress-tested to depth 20), idempotence 200/200 (fixpoint in ONE pass), validation 200/200. cost +37.6% statements, +16.8% steps.

planes.name: DEEP OPERAND
planes.metric: 7,143 chars = 0.48x crossover - NO MODEL - n-gram turns around at order 3
planes.verified: absorbs former L5/L6/L7. leaf 78.24%, reach 15.77%, container 5.99%. error 0.97+/-0.45 pts, mismatch 0.0, unclosed 0.0, KS 0.0490 < 0.0729, five seeds. 0 params beat a 15,089-param model by 10x on proportions.

rules: refuse a plane already paid for

rule_reach.note: per 1,000 nodes. idempotence and address are 0.0 above L1 because there are no statements inside an expression.

machine.validate: one linear pass per region, no execution, no control-flow graph
machine.verified: B1 B2 B4 B6 exact on interpreter, stack VM, register machine, and JIT. no unverified component remains.

factory.law: quantile is PER-CORPUS: measure H(depth), read it off. <0.7->0.50, <1.0->0.90, else 0.99. always round UP on an unseen key.

boundaries: naming: 61% of the information is not in the corpus. the orchestrator is not built and not derivable by counting.
visual languages: 4.7% of the Wikipedia list has no text form. nothing for a 13-symbol window to see.
closing: per-sequence, not per-step. no readout improvement reaches it, and neither does recurrent state - the GRU baseline proves it. -I is permanent.
scale: every result is at ~17k parameters on one primary corpus. at 17M the division of labour may not hold.

reproduction.corpus: Python 3.12 stdlib, 504 files, comments and string literals stripped, every identifier collapsed to I
reproduction.seeds: 5 seeds minimum for any generation claim. single-seed comparisons caused three of the nineteen corrections.
reproduction.crossover: ~15,000 tokens. below it a trained stack does not beat a bigram and no model should be placed.

not_built.why: 61% of naming information is not in the corpus in any form a counter reaches. structure explains 5.1% of the choice, arguments explain 64.2%, and the residual 2.033 bits is where meaning lives.
not_built.status: not derivable — a boundary, not a task

not_built.why: 4.7% of the Wikipedia list has no text form: Scratch, Simulink, Max, Grasshopper, Prograph, NXT-G, App Inventor. a language whose source is a picture has no I to collapse.
not_built.status: indexed so the factory REFUSES rather than guesses

not_built.why: every result here is at 17k params on one primary corpus. a 17M-parameter model may learn an exact stack, in which case the division of labour changes.

measured_dead: SWITCHBOARD
routing (kind, #calls, #args) -> name
0.0% top-1 on real held-out functions. the aggregate 20.5% was carried by slots whose answer is 'self'.
8 NAMED ATTENTION HEADS
prev-token, sink, same-char, class, delimiter, similarity, bigram, uniform
UNIFORM AVERAGING BEATS THEM: 0.9182 bits vs 0.9256. five of eight already had near-maximal entropy; the two that were sharp duplicated the one-hot features.
SEEDED CORPUS GENERATOR
600k synthetic tokens from a seed corpus
the pretraining gain was regularisation in disguise. once L2 and dropout were added it helped nothing.
WORD-BIGRAM FILTER
reject synthetic text with implausible adjacent pairs
+0.71 accuracy, noise level. the model already had that signal as an input feature.
LONG-RANGE COHERENCE GATE
JS divergence threshold on synthetic text
76% rejection for +0.2 perplexity and -0.14 accuracy. failed both metrics.
CONSTRAINED SAMPLING
bias -I fills toward the block centroid
both intrinsic statistics improved; downstream accuracy fell 0.67%.
CORPUS BLENDING
94k mixed-register words
lost to 29k pure by 17 perplexity units. register purity beats volume.
CLOSED-FORM READOUT
ridge solve instead of trained cross-entropy
0.86s, zero training, 73.8% top-1 — and 5.082 bits. unusable when sampled: no calibration, no sampling, diversity 1.000 on the generation test.
GREEDY DECODING
argmax instead of sampling
5-gram diversity 0.013. one 420-character line, never a newline.
WIDER WINDOW
CTX 26 and CTX 52
52 is WORSE than 13 (49.8% vs 52.9% on brackets). the window was never the bottleneck for prediction.
PATTERN IDEMPOTENCE
forbid a repeated k-statement block
would forbid 37.33% of real Python. real code repeats a 2-block a third of the time.
RUN-LENGTH HARD CAP
refuse a kind past N repeats
best cap improves KS by 42% and still differs. kills a genuine 0.23% tail to fix a 4.10% one. replaced by run PRESSURE a=0.3, which agrees at D=0.0099.
DENSITY METRIC
z-distance of construct densities from real code
shuffled characters scored 0.749 against real code's 0.996. distance-from-average rewards being suspiciously average.
BURSTINESS METRIC
within-sample density variation
AUC 0.33-0.43 — every condition including noise looked more real than real code.
'CLEAN' AS A QUALITY METRIC
zero mismatched, zero unclosed
20/20 on pure noise. it measured the substrate, never the model. every 30/30 quoted across nine languages was a claim about the veto.
GENERIC REGISTER SPILL
evaluate into R-1 and park in memory

unfixable in principle: reloading every spilled value into one register loses all but the last. deleted, not repaired. the calling convention handles arity; nothing needs more than 8 registers for depth.
